class.name: IfcPropertyTableValue
class.brief_description: A property with a range value ( IfcPropertyTableValue ) defines a property object which has two lists of (numeric or descriptive) values assigned, the values specifying a table with two columns. The defining values provide the first column and establish the scope for the defined values (the second column). Interpolations are out of scope of the IfcPropertyTableValue . An optional Expression attrib

members.member: List of defining values, which determine the defined values. This list shall have unique values only. IFC2x4 CHANGE The attribute has been made optional with upward compatibility for file based exchange.
Defined values which are applicable for the scope as defined by the defining values. IFC2x4 CHANGE The attribute has been made optional with upward compatibility for file based exchange.
Expression for the derivation of defined values from the defining values, the expression is given for information only, i.e. no automatic processing can be expected from the expression.
Unit for the defining values, if not given, the default value for the measure type (given by the TYPE of the defining values) is used as defined by the global unit assignment at IfcProject.
Unit for the defined values, if not given, the default value for the measure type (given by the TYPE of the defined values) is used as defined by the global unit assignment at IfcProject.

Interpolation of the curve between two defining and defined values that are provided. if not provided a linear interpolation is assumed. IFC2x4 CHANGE The attribute has been added at the end of the attribute list.
